sum: Grove Collaborative Holdings, Inc., a consumer products company, develops and sells household, personal care, beauty, and other consumer products in the United States. The company sells its products under the Grove-owned brands through direct-to-consumer platform through websites, mobile applications, and third parties. It sells through online and physical stores; physical, ecommerce, omnichannel retailers, vendors, distributors, and manufacturers; and web search engines, comparison shopping websites, social networks, and other online and app-based networks. Grove Collaborative Holdings, Inc. is headquartered in San Francisco, California.
